headings.usage: Use for all H1-H6. Break the Inter monotony. Highly modern and geometric.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, labels, and small text. Highly readable.

text.accent: text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-violet-600 via-fuchsia-600 to-blue-600

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-violet-600 to-fuchsia-600 text-white font-semibold rounded-full px-8 py-4 shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(139,92,246,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_25px_rgba(139,92,246,0.5)] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-zinc-900 border-2 border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-900 font-semibold rounded-full px-8 py-4 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1

cards.default: bg-white rounded-3xl border border-zinc-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl hover:border-violet-100 transition-all duration-500
cards.glass: bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-2xl rounded-3xl border border-white shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]

badges.style: inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-violet-200 bg-violet-50 px-3 py-1 text-sm font-medium text-violet-700 mb-6

1_hero.elements: Top badge ('✨ CaptionCraft AI 2.0'). Massive H1 with 'Viral Instagram Captions' in gradient text. Subtitle in text-lg text-zinc-600 max-w-2xl mx-auto. Buttons: Primary (Generate Free Captions) and Secondary (See Examples).
1_hero.visuals: Add massive, soft blurred animated background blobs (blur-[120px] bg-purple-300/30, bg-pink-300/30) behind the hero. Include an abstract visual mockup or floating caption cards using framer-motion.

2_features.layout: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid). Grid cols 1 md:grid-cols-3.
2_features.elements: 6 feature cards. 2 large cards spanning 2 columns each, 4 small cards spanning 1 column. Use Lucide icons with gradient backgrounds.
2_features.styling: Cards should have pure white backgrounds, subtle border-zinc-100, and a soft hover lift. Icons should be encased in soft pink/purple circular backgrounds.

3_how_it_works.elements: 1. Enter Topic, 2. Choose Tone, 3. AI Generates, 4. Post & Grow. Use arrows or connecting lines between steps. Include subtle lifestyle influencer images in circular avatars to represent 'growth'.

4_live_demo.layout: Split 2-column container. Left: Controls. Right: Output.
4_live_demo.elements: Left: Interactive form using Shadcn inputs. Fields: Topic (textarea), Category (select), Tone (select), Length (select). Generate Button. Right: A mocked Instagram post card showing the generated caption, hashtags, and a 'Copy to Clipboard' button.
4_live_demo.styling: The entire demo container should be a high-end glassmorphism card (bg-white/80, backdrop-blur-xl) resting over a soft gradient background to emphasize it's the core product.

5_benefits.elements: Show metrics like '10x Faster', '50% More Engagement', '10,000+ Creators'. Use massive typography for the numbers (text-6xl font-black gradient text).

6_testimonials.elements: Use influencer smiling selfie images. Star ratings. Real-sounding quotes. Card styling should be clean white with subtle drop shadows.

7_pricing.styling: Free card: standard styling. Pro card: The 'Tracing Beam' effect. Border gradient, prominent purple glow, and a 'Most Popular' badge.

8_faq.elements: Use Shadcn Accordion. Keep styling minimal, lines between items.

9_final_cta.styling: Dark mode inversion here to create impact! bg-zinc-900 text-white. Use the bright gradient colors for the button to make it pop wildly against the dark background.

10_footer.layout: Generous padding (py-24), clean grid for links.
10_footer.elements: Logo, social links, legal. Keep text small and muted (text-zinc-500).

abstract_backgrounds.description: Abstract purple and pink gradient waves
abstract_backgrounds.usage: Use as a low-opacity background behind the Live Demo section or Final CTA.
Use as an image mask or hero decoration element.

ui_mockups.usage: Use in the How It Works section or Hero as a decorative element.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, selects, form submit) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Example: data-testid='generate-caption-button'
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure gradient text is legible. The primary purple/pink/blue gradient meets APCA requirements over white and zinc-900. Do not use over gray.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'framer-motion' for scroll and hover animations.
Install '@fontsource/outfit' and '@fontsource/plus-jakarta-sans' or add them via Google Fonts in index.html.
Use standard Tailwind classes. For custom gradients or shadows specified in 'accents', use arbitrary values like shadow-[...].
Ensure the Live Demo section is actually interactive. The user should be able to type, click Generate, and see a simulated loading state before the result appears. Implement this using React state.
Implement the 'Tracing Beam' on the Pro pricing card using a border gradient and absolute positioned glow.
Do NOT center align everything. Keep text in Bento cards left-aligned. Asymmetry is preferred.
Strictly follow the color palette. Do not invent new shades of purple unless adjusting opacity.
Add data-testid attributes to all form inputs, buttons, and links.
